title: arracacia peruviana
intro: Arracacia peruviana, commonly known as arracacha, is a perennial plant native to the Andean region of South America, characterized by its edible roots and leaves. The health benefits of arracacha include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of arracacha include its use in traditional medicine to alleviate symptoms of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of arracacha include inulin, raffinose, and other oligosaccharides, which are responsible for its prebiotic and anti-inflammatory effects.
